units.translation: But you, be wise, as one who fears to neglect the gods.
For the race of mortals thinks only for the day.
But to the dead, not to the living, was the poor favor sent.
It is best for one who is wise to seem not to be wise.
Dare at last, in the face of present troubles, to think rightly.
To the one who thinks not well.
Now listen with understanding.
So as not to think well.
The one who set mortals on the path of thinking.
Not to think badly is the greatest gift of god.
Think, you goddesses beneath the earth.
And Zeus gave me too the ability to think not badly.
Do you find the path of a wise and good tongue?
Children, you must be wise; and you have come with a wise and faithful old man.
You speak wisely to the wise (I corrected φρονοῦσαν [thinking] to φρονοῦντας [thinking]).
For the eye of one who thinks well accuses you.
As before, thinking well of me.
But are you pleased with what has now been announced?

Until the mind of Zeus abates its wrath.
A savage spirit, not named after maidens, with a grim eye.
A spirit of windless calm, an unshaken ornament of wealth.
I remember hearing of your spirit.
Having acquired a godless spirit for her children.
The spirit of the dead is not subdued by the raging jaw of fire.
Who could describe the over-bold spirit of the man?
Because of daring and unjust spirit.
Sitting (Hermann: μνῆμον [mindful]) above, he somehow accomplished his spirit from there.
From what spirit (I corrected τίνος [of what] to ποίου [of what kind]) of Pelasgian men do you dishonor this land?
This is not to be deceived by my spirit.
For vain thoughts of men the tongue becomes a true accuser.
Penalty for insolence and godless thoughts.
Chastiser of overly arrogant thoughts.
The speech is solemn-mouthed and full of pride.
Poison falling to the ground from thoughts.
thoughts

The rest, care not overcome by sleep, will set right.
I am at a loss, deprived of thoughts, of resourceful care (Karsten: εὐπαλάμων μεριμνᾶν [of resourceful cares]).
Winged with cares.
There is need of deep saving thought.
Does it not seem necessary to have saving thought?
And care tears at my heart.
Hope wards off insatiable care.
Burden of care.

I dismiss this care from the way.
